title: Maximum nonlinearity of Boolean functions in odd dimensions
summary: Determine the exact maximum nonlinearity of an n-variable Boolean function for every odd n at least 9; later resilient constructions improve lower bounds but do not settle the unrestricted extremal value.

formal_statement.body: For every odd integer $n >= 9$, determine $max_{f:F_2^n -> F_2} NL(f)$, where $NL(f)$ is the Hamming distance from the first-order Reed--Muller code. A complete answer requires matching upper bounds and attaining functions for every such $n$.

scope.domain: Boolean-function nonlinearity and first-order Reed--Muller covering radius
assumptions: Nonlinearity is distance from affine Boolean functions
scope.unresolved_remainder: The exact unrestricted maximum and an attaining function remain unknown for the full family of odd dimensions n>=9; later results inspect only resilient or otherwise restricted subclasses and improve attainable lower bounds.
